title: Load JSON Node
outcome_summary: Added the LoadJsonNode (JSON Load File) as the fourteenth node in the comfyui-json-nodes package, completing the load/save cycle. The node scans ComfyUI's input directory for .json files at startup, uses mtime-based fingerprint_inputs() for cache invalidation, applies a path-traversal guard in both execute() and fingerprint_inputs(), and validates that the top-level JSON value is a dict. All 9 acceptance criteria were met across 5 pipeline stages (implementation, QA, security-audit, code-review, documentation) with 17 tests passing and 0 security findings at Critical/High/Medium severity; an orchestrator mid-run crash was cleanly recovered via the Ledger Doctor without data loss.
